nieuw.titel: Use Men-at-Arms as a cheap combat-resolution block
nieuw.tekst: He considers Men-at-Arms an effective infantry choice for winning through numbers and combat resolution.
nieuw.waarom: He credits their low cost, at about 200 points at most, and their ability to reach seven combat resolution. He says that resolution can beat a dragon's overkill when it is challenged, and also values their two champion options, built-in Shieldwall and Warband.

bronnen.citaat: It's an infantry unit that can beat other units through strength in numbers

extraCitaten.citaat: the reason it's effective in the game is it's cheap.

nieuw.titel: Consider skipping the Stubborn upgrade for Men-at-Arms
nieuw.tekst: He does not think the 25-point upgrade giving Men-at-Arms Stubborn seems worthwhile.
nieuw.waarom: He says the unit already has Shieldwall, which he describes as a weaker effect with similarities to Stubborn.

bronnen.citaat: for 25 points doesn't seem worth it.

nieuw.titel: Favour monstrous infantry for a Death Star
nieuw.tekst: He thinks monstrous infantry, particularly ogres, tends to be the best way to build an infantry Death Star.
nieuw.waarom: He says a Death Star needs a large wound count and the ability to strike back to win central combats through wounds.

bronnen.citaat: the monstrous infantry version with ogres tends to be the best way to play

extraCitaten.citaat: it's that large wound count and the ability to strike back that matters.

nieuw.titel: March a Death Star into the enemy's wheel arc
nieuw.tekst: Rather than charging immediately, march a Death Star close into the enemy's wheel arc to restrict its movement. Set up a reliable charge next turn while occupying valuable space in the centre.
nieuw.waarom: He says units cannot wheel backwards. If the Death Star charges and loses instead, the opponent can restrain, reform and escape, which has happened to him.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that the enemy can still reform when its wheeling is blocked.

bronnen.citaat: you want with this sort of unit not to charge almost,

extraCitaten.citaat: by marching into their wheel arc. Units can't wheel backwards.

nieuw.titel: Use Death Star champions to absorb the enemy's attacks
nieuw.tekst: When a Death Star is charged, use its champion to challenge the enemy's nominated attacker. This leaves the general or other big hitter in the front rank to hit back.

bronnen.citaat: It can use challenges, especially when you're being charged

extraCitaten.citaat: your general or big hitter can hit back

nieuw.titel: Consider Sisters of Avelorn for points-preserving harassment
nieuw.tekst: He rates Sisters of Avelorn as probably the best option for a harassment unit whose priority is staying alive and preserving its points.
nieuw.waarom: He values their protection from shooting through Skirmish, their ability to move through cover and their Evasive rule, which makes them difficult to catch.

bronnen.citaat: sisters tend to be the best at it

nieuw.titel: Prioritise valuable targets with Sisters of Avelorn
nieuw.tekst: Use Sisters of Avelorn to prioritise high-value shooting targets such as Tomb Banshees and heavy cavalry.
nieuw.waarom: He points to their high armour piercing, magical attacks and 30-inch range. He also says ignoring cover helps them hit consistently.

bronnen.citaat: you can really prioritize high value targets

extraCitaten.citaat: Ignoring cover means you're going to hit a lot.

nieuw.titel: Use harassment infantry on a flank near terrain
nieuw.tekst: Use mobile harassment infantry on a flank near terrain to delay or kill opposing units. If it gets into trouble, march it into cover and out of line of sight to preserve its points.
nieuw.waarom: He says this can diminish the opponent's resources in one part of the board and allow the army's hammers to strike harder elsewhere.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He does not see this type of unit as the army's centrepiece or as something that necessarily holds the centre.

bronnen.citaat: it can sit on a flank near terrain and delay or kill opposing units.

extraCitaten.citaat: they can march away into cover

nieuw.titel: Prefer great weapons on competitive Grave Guard
nieuw.tekst: He thinks great weapons are the better way to equip Grave Guard for competitive play.
nieuw.waarom: In his view, great weapons turn them into a blender that can grind through any unit.

bronnen.citaat: great weapons, which I think is the better way to play them competitively

extraCitaten.citaat: they can grind through any unit

nieuw.titel: Use Drilled to widen Grave Guard after taking a charge
nieuw.tekst: If taking Drilled on Grave Guard, use it to fan out after receiving a charge and giving ground, choosing a formation that maximises their attacks.
nieuw.waarom: He says this gives Drilled a use even though the unit cannot march.

bronnen.citaat: you've been charged, you take the hit, and then you fan out

extraCitaten.citaat: maximize your attacks on give grounds and things like that.

bron.citaat: I think they do offer a very effective path to play infantry in this game.

aanvullingen.toelichting: He likewise endorses a large, durable Death Star as an effective competitive infantry choice.
